Frequently Asked Questions

# Straight *Answers*

Everything people ask us most often — hours, location, appointments, services, gift cards. If you have a question we haven't answered, [text us at (423) 537-4221](sms:+14235374221) and we'll get back to you same day.

## Location, Hours & Contact

### Quick answer

**1202 Hixson Pike, Chattanooga, TN 37405** &middot; [(423) 218-2841](tel:+14232182841) &middot; [Text (423) 537-4221](sms:+14235374221) &middot; Monday–Saturday 9am–7pm, Sunday 10am–7pm &middot; **By appointment only**.

**Q: Where is Amber & Sage Spa located?**

Amber & Sage Spa is located at **1202 Hixson Pike, Chattanooga, TN 37405** — in the heart of North Chattanooga, just off the North Shore. We have free parking on-site.

**Q: What are Amber & Sage Spa's hours?**

**Monday through Saturday, 9am to 7pm. Sunday, 10am to 7pm.** All visits are by appointment only.

**Q: What is the phone number for Amber & Sage Spa?**

Call us at **[(423) 218-2841](tel:+14232182841)** or text **[(423) 537-4221](sms:+14235374221)**. Text is often the fastest way to reach us.

**Q: Is Amber & Sage open on Sundays?**

Yes. Sunday hours are 10am to 7pm, by appointment only.

**Q: How far is Amber & Sage from downtown Chattanooga?**

About 10 minutes by car. We're just north of the Tennessee River. From downtown, cross the Market Street Bridge and continue up Hixson Pike.

**Q: How far is Amber & Sage from Signal Mountain?**

About 15 minutes from the top of Signal Mountain, either down W Road or down the Boulevard. Both routes lead directly to Hixson Pike. [More details for Signal Mountain residents.](spa-signal-mountain.html)

**Q: How far is Amber & Sage from Red Bank?**

About 8–10 minutes down Dayton Boulevard, which turns into Hixson Pike. [More details for Red Bank residents.](spa-red-bank.html)

## Booking & Appointments

**Q: Do I need an appointment at Amber & Sage Spa?**

Yes. We are by appointment only — no walk-ins. This lets us maintain the calm, unrushed environment we're known for.

**Q: How do I book an appointment?**

The easiest way is [online, 24/7](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649). You can also call [(423) 218-2841](tel:+14232182841) or text [(423) 537-4221](sms:+14235374221) during business hours.

**Q: What should I expect on my first visit?**

Arrive about 5 minutes early. We'll send you a text when it's time to come inside, so you can decompress in your car first. You'll be greeted with your choice of soothing tea or cold water, settled in a robe, and walked back to a private treatment room. Your therapist or esthetician will personalize the session to what your body or skin needs that day.

## Services

**Q: What services does Amber & Sage Spa offer?**

We're a holistic day spa. Our services include: [organic facials](eminence-organic-facials-chattanooga.html) (partnered with Éminence Organic Skin Care), [therapeutic massage](deep-tissue-massage-chattanooga.html), [reiki](what-is-reiki.html), [sound baths](sound-bath-chattanooga.html), [aura photography](aura-photography-chattanooga.html) using the AuraCloud 3D Pro system, [lash and brow services](lash-and-brow-chattanooga.html), [full-body waxing](waxing-chattanooga.html), and [body scrubs](body-scrub-chattanooga.html).

**Q: What kind of facials does Amber & Sage offer?**

10 facial options including our 30-minute Express Facial, Personalized Éminence Facial, Dermaplane Facial, [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html), [Microdermabrasion](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html), [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html) (in 8 variants), [Glow and Sculpt Facial](glow-and-sculpt-facial-chattanooga.html), and our 2-hour [Buccal Facial Massage](best-buccal-massage-chattanooga.html). See the [decision guide](which-facial-should-i-get.html) if you're not sure which is right.

**Q: Which oxygen facial variant should I pick?**

For first-timers with no specific concern, start with **Rejuvenate**. For aging: **Rejuve + Collagen**. For dullness: **Rejuve + Vitamin C3**. For hyperpigmentation: **Opulence Brightening**. For a major event: **GlowTox**. See the full [Which Oxygen Facial? decision guide](which-oxygen-facial-should-i-get.html).

**Q: Does Amber & Sage offer chemical peels?**

No — we only offer **enzyme peels**, not chemical peels. Enzyme peels use plant-derived enzymes from papaya, pumpkin, and pineapple to gently exfoliate without acids. If your skin requires a chemical peel, we'll refer you to a trusted Chattanooga dermatologist or med-spa. [Comparison guide.](enzyme-peel-vs-chemical-peel.html)

**Q: Does Amber & Sage do couples massage?**

We don't offer traditional same-room couples massage. What we *do* offer is two massages scheduled at the same time in adjoining rooms — you and your partner start and finish together, then meet in the relaxation area afterward. Many regulars actually prefer this format.

**Q: Does Amber & Sage do Brazilian waxing?**

Yes — Brazilian and bikini waxing are available for female clients. Our full [waxing menu](waxing-chattanooga.html) also includes brow, lip, chin, underarm, arm, leg, and back waxing.

**Q: Does Amber & Sage offer aura photography?**

Yes. We use the **AuraCloud 3D Pro** — the current industry-leading aura imaging technology from Inneractive. Our basic session is about 15 minutes; we also offer an upgraded reading with a detailed personalized PDF report emailed afterward. Pairs and couples sittings are available on request. [More on our aura sessions.](aura-photography-chattanooga.html)

**Q: What Éminence products does Amber & Sage use?**

We are a **Proudly Partnered Éminence Organic Skin Care** provider. Every facial uses Éminence products, and we retail the full line. Our estheticians are Éminence-certified and receive ongoing brand training.

## Gift Cards, Events & Extras

**Q: Do Amber & Sage gift cards expire?**

Our gift cards are **valid for 5 years** from the date of purchase. There are no maintenance fees that erode the balance. Cards are available digitally (instantly emailable) or physically from our **24/7 self-serve gift card box** outside our entrance.

Digital gift cards are available [online](https://clients.mangomint.com/gift-cards/amberandsage) and delivered by email within seconds. Physical gift cards are available 24/7 from the self-serve box outside our front entrance, or [book a quick retail appointment](https://booking.mangomint.com/amberandsage?serviceId=74) to pick one up in person. [Full gift card details.](gift-cards-chattanooga.html)

**Q: Does Amber & Sage host bachelorette parties or private events?**

Yes. We host bachelorette parties, corporate wellness events, milestone birthdays, bridal parties, and custom private groups. Every event is **custom-designed** rather than pre-packaged. [Text (423) 537-4221](sms:+14235374221) with your group size, date range, and occasion to start planning. [More on private events.](private-events-chattanooga.html)

**Q: Is tipping expected at Amber & Sage?**

Yes — **20% has become the new standard**, mirroring restaurant tipping. For exceptional service or regular therapists you've built a relationship with, 20–25% is common. You can tip directly through our booking system.

**Q: Is Amber & Sage the same as Natural Body?**

No. Amber & Sage is a separate, independently owned holistic day spa. Our previous Natural Body gift card redemption agreement ended April 30, 2026, and Natural Body cards are no longer accepted.

# Decision Guide: Which Facial Should I Get?

Source: https://amberandsagespa.com/which-facial-should-i-get.html

A Decision Guide

# Which Facial Should *I* Get?

An honest guide to choosing the right facial at Amber & Sage. We offer ten options — here's how to find the one that's actually right for you.

[Pick by Goal](#by-goal)
[Side-by-Side Table](#comparison)

If you're not sure what you want, our most flexible recommendation is the [**Personalized Éminence Facial (1 hour,)**](eminence-organic-facials-chattanooga.html). It's customized to your skin that day, and your esthetician will recommend more specific facials for future visits based on what she sees. You can stop reading and book that — you'll be in good hands.

## The Quick Answer

If you have a clear goal, here's the shortest possible answer to "which facial should I get?"

**Want a quick refresh or lunch-break maintenance?** → Express Facial

**Want the all-rounder, customized to your skin?** → Personalized Éminence Facial

**Want immediately smoother skin and that "lit from within" glow?** → Dermaplane Facial

**Just the dermaplaning, none of the extras?** → Single Dermaplane

**Dealing with active breakouts or persistent acne?** → [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html)

**Want serious texture refinement and pore reduction?** → [Microderm Facial](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html) (full or express)

**Big event in the next week? Need a hydration boost?** → [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html) ([8 variants — which to pick?](which-oxygen-facial-should-i-get.html))

**Want gentle lift, sculpting, and the most relaxing experience?** → [Glow and Sculpt Facial](glow-and-sculpt-facial-chattanooga.html)

**Carry tension in your jaw, or want maximum lower-face lift?** → [Buccal Facial Massage](best-buccal-massage-chattanooga.html)

## Pick By Your Primary Goal

Most facial choices start with one of these questions. Here's where to land based on what you actually want.

### "I want my skin to look better right away."

**Best choices:** Dermaplane Facial, Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial, Glow and Sculpt Facial.

All three produce immediate visible results — dermaplane for smoothness and glow, oxygen for plumpness and hydration, glow and sculpt for lift and definition. Choose based on what kind of "better" you want.

### "I want consistent ongoing skin health."

**Best choice:** Personalized Éminence Facial, on a monthly cadence.

This is our most-booked maintenance facial because it's fully customized each visit. Your skin needs different things in different seasons, hormonal phases, and stress periods — the Personalized Éminence adapts every time.

### "I'm dealing with active breakouts or acne."

**Best choice:** [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html).

The six-step protocol (extractions + enzyme exfoliation + high frequency + red light) is built specifically for breakout-prone skin. Avoid dermaplaning and microderm during active breakouts.

### "I want serious texture and tone work."

**Best choice:** [Microderm Facial](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html) (1 hour,).

For surface texture, pore appearance, fine lines, and mild sun damage. More aggressive than dermaplaning. For maintenance after an initial series, the Express Microderm keeps results going.

### "I'm prepping for a big event."

**Best choice (5–7 days out):** [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html).

The same system Madonna popularized. Immediate visible plumpness, hydration, and glow that photographs beautifully. For maximum effect, build a small series in the weeks before.

### "I want to relax and have my face look better."

**Best choice:** [Glow and Sculpt Facial](glow-and-sculpt-facial-chattanooga.html).

The heated neck pillow and cool jade comb sequence make this our most genuinely relaxing facial. Visible lift and sculpting without sacrificing the spa experience.

### "I clench my jaw" or "I want serious lower-face lift."

**Best choice:** [Buccal Facial Massage](best-buccal-massage-chattanooga.html) (2 hours,).

Our standalone intra-oral facial massage service. Releases jaw tension and lifts the lower face in a way no surface treatment can replicate.

### "I just want to try a facial without committing."

**Best choice:** Express Facial (30 min,).

Same Éminence products, same consultation quality, just a shorter format. Great for first-timers, lunch-break refreshers, and maintenance between deeper visits.

## Pick By How Much Time You Have

### 30 minutes

Express Facial, Single Dermaplane, or Express Microderm Facial. All three are streamlined for maintenance or a quick refresh.

### 45 minutes

[Glow and Sculpt Facial](glow-and-sculpt-facial-chattanooga.html) or [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html). Distinctive, full-experience facials that fit between meetings.

### 1 hour

Personalized Éminence Facial, Dermaplane Facial, or [Microderm Facial](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html). Our standard full-experience formats.

### ~90 minutes

[Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html) or any of our 1-hour facials with layered enhancements. Facial cupping (+15), light therapy (+15), and high frequency (+5) can extend any facial.

### 2 hours

[Buccal Facial Massage](best-buccal-massage-chattanooga.html). Our most substantive standalone session, dedicated to intra-oral facial massage and deep lower-face work.

## Pick By Budget

Real talk on what each price point gets you:

### Budget-friendly options

These are real facials, not stripped-down placeholders. Same Éminence products, same consultation, just a more focused 30 minutes. Excellent for maintenance, between-visit refreshers, and first-time visitors.

### Standard tier

Our "main course" range. Personalized Éminence, Glow and Sculpt, Express Microderm, and Dermaplane Facial all sit here. Full experience, no shortcuts.

### Standard tier

Our most substantive sessions: full Microderm, Acne Facial, and Buccal Facial Massage. These are session-and-a-half experiences with comprehensive multi-modality protocols.

## Pick By Skin Concern

### Sensitive or reactive skin

**Best:** Personalized Éminence Facial or [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html).

Both are gentle, non-mechanical, and use clean, organic products. **Avoid:** Microdermabrasion (mechanical exfoliation can aggravate) and Glow and Sculpt during flare-ups (dermaplaning can be irritating).

### Acne-prone or breakout-active skin

**Best:** [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html).

Multi-modality protocol designed for this. **Avoid:** Dermaplaning and microderm during active outbreaks (blade and diamond tip can spread bacteria).

### Mature skin or visible aging

**Best:** [Microderm Facial](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html) + occasional Dermaplane Facial. Add red light therapy as an enhancement.

For deeper lower-face lift, layer in [Buccal Facial Massage](best-buccal-massage-chattanooga.html) sessions every 4–6 weeks.

### Dehydrated or dull skin

**Best:** [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html).

The hyaluronic acid infusion produces visible plumpness that no topical product matches. **Also great:** Personalized Éminence with hydrating mask focus.

### Hyperpigmentation or sun damage

**Best:** [Microderm Facial](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html) series + Personalized Éminence with brightening Éminence products.

Surface pigmentation responds well; deeper concerns may need dermatology referral, which we'll tell you honestly.

### Puffiness or fluid retention

**Best:** [Glow and Sculpt Facial](glow-and-sculpt-facial-chattanooga.html).

The cool jade comb work targets lymphatic drainage specifically. Same-day visible reduction.

### Congested pores (blackheads, whiteheads)

**Best:** [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html) (extractions are core to the protocol).

Even if you don't have active acne, the comprehensive extraction-focused approach is the right tool.

## Pick By Scenario

### First time at a spa

**Recommended:** Personalized Éminence Facial.

Most flexible, most customizable, and your esthetician will use the visit to learn your skin and recommend specific facials for future bookings.

### Pre-wedding (you're the bride/groom)

**Plan a series over 6–8 weeks.** Start with a Personalized Éminence to establish baseline skin health. Add 2–3 monthly [Microderm](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html) sessions if you want serious texture work. Book the [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html) 5–7 days before the wedding for maximum glow on the day.

### Monthly maintenance

Pick one of the 1-hour facials and stick with it for 3–4 months to see compounding effects. Personalized Éminence, Dermaplane, or Microderm are all excellent. Alternate every other month if you want variety.

### Lunch break or between meetings

**Best:** Express Facial (30 min,) or Express Microderm Facial (30 min,).

### Milestone birthday or anniversary

**Best:** [Buccal Facial Massage](best-buccal-massage-chattanooga.html) (2 hours,) for the experience, or pair a 1-hour facial with a 60-minute massage.

### Post-illness or post-surgery recovery

**Best:** [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html).

Gentle, non-invasive, immediately restorative. Wait for any acute medical clearance first.

### Pregnant or nursing

**Best:** Personalized Éminence Facial, [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html), or [Glow and Sculpt Facial](glow-and-sculpt-facial-chattanooga.html).

All are pregnancy-safe with proper product selection. Tell us when you book so we can adapt accordingly.

### Gift for someone, but you don't know their skin

**Best:** A [gift card](gift-cards-chattanooga.html) in a flexible amount. They'll choose what's right for them, and our gift cards are valid for 5 years.

## Don't Forget the Enhancements

Any of our 1-hour facials can be extended with layered enhancements. These aren't separate services — they're additions that extend your session and amplify results:

- **Facial cupping** — +15 minutes. Lymphatic drainage and depuffing with small silicone cups.
- **Light therapy (LED)** — +15 minutes. Red and near-infrared light for collagen support and inflammation reduction. [More on red light →](what-is-red-light-therapy.html)
- **High frequency** — +5 minutes. Low-level current via glass electrode for acne bacteria and inflammation.
- **Enzyme peel** — plant-based exfoliation, gentler than chemical peels. [Enzyme vs. chemical peel →](enzyme-peel-vs-chemical-peel.html)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What if I don't know which facial to choose?**

Start with the Personalized Éminence Facial — our 1-hour signature service. It's our most flexible offering, fully customized to your skin that day, and your esthetician can recommend specific facials or enhancements for future visits based on what she sees.

**Q: Should I get a facial before or after my wedding?**

Both, ideally. Build a series in the 6–8 weeks leading up to the wedding so your skin is at its best on the day. The Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial is the most common pre-event choice — book it 5–7 days before for optimal results. Afterward, a Personalized Éminence Facial or Glow and Sculpt can be a perfect honeymoon reset.

**Q: How often should I get a facial?**

For ongoing skin maintenance, once a month aligns with your skin's natural renewal cycle. For active concerns like acne or hyperpigmentation, every 2–3 weeks for a short series, then transition to monthly maintenance. For special occasions, schedule strategically — usually 5–7 days before the event.

**Q: Can I get a facial if I have active breakouts?**

Yes — the Acne Facial is specifically designed for breakout-prone skin. Avoid dermaplaning and microdermabrasion during active breakouts (the blade or diamond tip can spread bacteria), and skip glow and sculpt for the same reason. The Acne Facial uses extractions, enzyme exfoliation, high frequency, and red light therapy — all appropriate for active acne.

**Q: What's the cheapest facial that's still actually worth it?**

Our Express Facial. It's 30 minutes, uses the same Éminence Organic Skin Care products we use in every facial, and includes a real consultation, double cleanse, and skin-specific product application. It's not just a cleanse — it's a complete miniature facial. Great for maintenance between deeper sessions or for first-time visitors who want to try us out.

**Q: Can I combine two facials into one visit?**

Sometimes, yes — with planning. We don't recommend stacking aggressive treatments (e.g., chemical exfoliation + microderm + dermaplaning in one session). But pairing a facial with an Éminence-based service or a massage is common. Text us in advance and we'll design the right flow.

**Q: I'm still not sure. Can you help me decide?**

Yes. Text us at (423) 537-4221 or call (423) 218-2841 with what you're looking for — even if you can only describe it as "I want my skin to look better and I have to spend" — and we'll recommend the right starting point.

# Decision Guide: Which Oxygen Facial?

Source: https://amberandsagespa.com/which-oxygen-facial-should-i-get.html

A Decision Guide

# Which Oxygen Facial Is *Right* for Me?

Our Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial comes in 8 variants. Here's how to choose, by skin concern, by occasion, by budget.

[Pick by Concern](#by-concern)
[See the Comparison](#comparison)

If this is your first Intraceuticals session and you don't have a specific concern in mind, start with **Rejuvenate**. It's the base hydration infusion — the gentlest variant and the one most clients fall in love with on first try. You can layer targeted serums in future sessions once you know how your skin responds.

## The Quick Answer

**First-time, no specific concern?** → Rejuvenate

**Aging / sagging / firmness?** → Rejuve + Collagen

**Dull / lackluster / want a brighter tone?** → Rejuve + Vitamin C3

**Sun damage / environmental stress?** → Rejuvenate + Antiox

**Fine lines / texture / anti-aging maintenance?** → Rejuvenate + Vitamin A

**Acne-prone / oily / congested?** → Clarity

**Hyperpigmentation / melasma / uneven tone?** → Opulence Brightening

**Major event in the next week and you want maximum impact?** → GlowTox

## Each Variant, Explained

### Rejuvenate —

The flagship infusion. Hyaluronic acid + vitamins delivered into the upper layers of skin via pressurized oxygen. Pure hydration and plumpness, no targeted active.

**Best for:** First-time Intraceuticals clients, sensitive skin, monthly maintenance, anyone who wants pure glow without addressing a specific concern. Pregnancy-safe.

### Rejuve + Collagen —

Rejuvenate base + a layered collagen-supporting serum. Targets firmness, elasticity, and the visible effects of natural collagen loss.

**Best for:** Clients in their 40s and beyond, anyone noticing skin laxity, post-weight-loss clients, mature skin maintenance.

### Rejuve + Vitamin C3 —

Rejuvenate base + a layered Vitamin C3 serum. C3 is a stabilized form of vitamin C that brightens, evens tone, and protects against free radical damage.

**Best for:** Dull or fatigued skin, after travel, post-illness recovery, anyone wanting an immediate brightening boost. Excellent before photos.

### Rejuvenate + Antiox —

Rejuvenate base + a concentrated antioxidant serum. Targets environmental damage from UV, pollution, and oxidative stress.

**Best for:** Summer months in Tennessee sun, runners and cyclists who train outdoors, urban commuters, post-vacation recovery, anyone with cumulative sun damage.

### Rejuvenate + Vitamin A —

Rejuvenate base + a retinol-adjacent Vitamin A serum. Vitamin A is the gold-standard anti-aging active — targets fine lines, texture, and uneven tone.

**Best for:** Anti-aging maintenance, clients who can't tolerate at-home retinol, mature skin. **Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding.**

### Clarity —

A targeted infusion designed for blemish-prone, oily, or congested skin. Contains salicylic acid and tea tree alongside the hydration base.

**Best for:** Active breakouts (mild), oily skin, congested pores, post-acne maintenance. Pairs well with our [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html) protocol for clients dealing with persistent breakouts.

### Opulence Brightening —

A specialized brightening infusion targeting hyperpigmentation, melasma, sun spots, and uneven tone. Contains brightening botanicals plus licorice root extract.

**Best for:** Hyperpigmentation, melasma, post-acne dark spots, uneven tone. Most effective as a monthly series rather than one-off booking.

### GlowTox —

Our premium variant. Contains peptides that temporarily relax muscle activity at the skin surface — producing a visible smoothing of expression lines (forehead, crow's feet, around the mouth) that lasts several days to a couple of weeks.

**Best for:** Pre-event prep (weddings, photoshoots, milestone birthdays), clients curious about Botox-like effects without injectables, dramatic same-day visible smoothing for a major occasion. Book 2–5 days before the event for peak effect.

Note: GlowTox is not a replacement for actual Botox if you want months of smoothing. It's the closest non-injectable equivalent for short-term, event-driven impact.

## Pick By Scenario

### "It's my first time getting an oxygen facial."

**Choose:** Rejuvenate. Gentlest, most flattering, lowest commitment. Your esthetician will recommend a more targeted variant for next time based on what she sees.

### "I'm getting married in the next month."

**Pre-wedding series:** Book a Rejuvenate or Rejuve + Vitamin C3 every 2–3 weeks in the lead-up. The week of the wedding: **GlowTox, 2–5 days before**. The combination of hydration buildup plus the GlowTox event-day finish is unbeatable.

### "My skin is dull and I have a big event in 5 days."

**Choose:** Rejuve + Vitamin C3 for brightness, or GlowTox if you want maximum impact and the budget supports it.

### "I've got persistent breakouts."

**Choose:** Clarity. Consider also booking the full [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html) protocol — it's a more comprehensive multi-step treatment for ongoing breakouts.

### "I'm dealing with melasma from pregnancy or sun."

**Choose:** Opulence Brightening, monthly for at least 3–4 months. Hyperpigmentation responds to consistent treatment more than to single sessions. Add [Microderm](microderm-facial-chattanooga.html) in alternating months for additional surface work.

### "I want to start an anti-aging routine."

**Rotate:** Rejuve + Collagen and Rejuve + Vitamin A every other month. Add Antiox during summer. Add GlowTox for special events.

### "I'm pregnant and want an oxygen facial."

**Choose:** Rejuvenate, Rejuve + Vitamin C3, or Opulence Brightening. **Avoid Rejuve + Vitamin A and GlowTox during pregnancy or breastfeeding.** Tell us when you book.

### "I just want the cheapest option that still feels like the real Intraceuticals experience."

**Choose:** Rejuvenate. It's the foundation of every Intraceuticals session and many clients prefer it long-term because it's the most universally flattering.

## Should You Add Enhancements?

Most of our Intraceuticals clients book the oxygen facial as a standalone. But certain enhancements pair beautifully:

- **Dermaplane** — performed before the Intraceuticals so the serums penetrate more evenly into freshly exfoliated skin.
- **Facial Cupping (++15 min)** — depuffs and stimulates circulation. The combination of cupping + oxygen infusion is our favorite pre-event protocol.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What's the difference between all the Rejuvenate variants?**

Rejuvenate is the base hydration infusion — hyaluronic acid plus vitamins. The "+" variants add a specific targeted serum on top of that hydration base. Collagen adds firming support; Vitamin C3 adds brightening antioxidants; Antiox adds environmental-damage protection; Vitamin A adds retinol-adjacent anti-aging. Same base, layered with one targeted concern.

**Q: Is GlowTox actually like Botox?**

Not pharmacologically, but it produces a similar visible smoothing effect on expression lines through a different mechanism. GlowTox uses peptides that temporarily relax muscle activity at the surface — visible smoothing of forehead lines, crow's feet, and around the mouth that lasts several days to a couple of weeks. It's not a replacement for actual Botox if you want months of smoothing, but it's the closest non-injectable equivalent for a single special-event treatment.

**Q: Should I always start with Rejuvenate as a first-timer?**

Yes, usually. Rejuvenate at is the gentlest, most universally flattering variant — pure hydration and glow without any targeted active serum. It's a great way to see how your skin responds to the Intraceuticals system before committing to a higher-priced variant for a specific concern.

**Q: Can I get a different variant each time?**

Absolutely. Many regulars rotate by season or by current concern — Rejuvenate for monthly maintenance, Antiox during summer, Vitamin C3 after travel, GlowTox before a major event. Your esthetician can recommend a rotation strategy based on your skin's needs over the year.

**Q: What if I have multiple concerns?**

Pick the variant that matches your top concern. If you have multiple priorities — say, both pigmentation and aging — rotate between Opulence Brightening and Rejuve + Vitamin A across consecutive monthly visits rather than trying to stack them. Each variant is engineered to deliver its specific actives at optimal concentration.

**Q: Which variants are safe during pregnancy?**

Rejuvenate, Rejuve + Collagen, Rejuve + Vitamin C3, Rejuve + Antiox, Clarity, and Opulence Brightening are generally pregnancy-safe. **Avoid Rejuvenate + Vitamin A and GlowTox during pregnancy and breastfeeding** — Vitamin A and the peptides in GlowTox are not recommended. Always confirm with your provider and tell us when you book.

**Q: How often should I get the oxygen facial?**

Monthly is the typical cadence for maintenance. For active concerns (melasma, persistent dullness, anti-aging), every 2–3 weeks for a short series, then transition to monthly. For event prep, schedule strategically — 2–5 days before for GlowTox; 5–7 days before for other variants.

# Comparison: Enzyme Peel vs. Chemical Peel

Source: https://amberandsagespa.com/enzyme-peel-vs-chemical-peel.html

A Practical Comparison

# Enzyme Peel vs. *Chemical Peel*

Two very different ways to exfoliate your skin — with very different mechanisms, intensities, and ideal use cases. Here's how to choose.

[Book an Enzyme Peel Facial](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)
[Compare Side-by-Side](#side-by-side)

## The Short Answer

**Enzyme peels** use plant-derived enzymes (from papaya, pumpkin, pineapple, and similar sources) to dissolve dead surface skin cells. They're gentle, organic, pregnancy-safe, and require no downtime. They're ideal for monthly maintenance, sensitive skin, and people who prefer a clean-ingredient approach.

**Chemical peels** use acids — typically glycolic, lactic, salicylic, mandelic, or trichloroacetic (TCA) — to chemically break down skin layers, sometimes reaching well below the surface. They're more aggressive, can address deeper concerns like significant scarring and melasma, and depending on strength require days to weeks of recovery. They're usually performed in medical or med-spa settings.

Both are valid. They answer different questions about your skin.

## Side-by-Side

Enzyme Peel
Chemical Peel

Mechanism
Plant-derived enzymes digest dead skin cells on the surface (the stratum corneum).
Acids chemically break down skin layers, sometimes reaching well below the surface.

Key ingredients
Papain (papaya), bromelain (pineapple), pumpkin enzymes, sometimes blueberry or other fruit enzymes.
Glycolic, lactic, salicylic, mandelic, TCA. Various strengths.

Depth
Surface only — stratum corneum.
Light (surface), medium (epidermis), or deep (dermis), depending on the acid and concentration.

Intensity
Gentle. Mild tingling at most.
Light peels feel tingly; deeper peels burn and require medical supervision.

Downtime
None. You can wear makeup the same day.
Light: minimal. Medium: 3–7 days of visible peeling. Deep: 1–2 weeks recovery.

Best for
Dullness, surface texture, congestion, sensitive skin, monthly maintenance.
Hyperpigmentation, melasma, deeper scarring, sun damage, aging concerns.

Pregnancy-safe
Yes, generally.
Light glycolic/lactic may be okay; salicylic and stronger acids typically avoided.

Setting
Holistic spas, organic-focused estheticians.
Medical spas, dermatology offices, or estheticians with advanced peel certification.

Cadence
Monthly, often as part of a regular facial.
Every 4–8 weeks for light; less frequently for deeper peels.

Cost (Chattanooga range)
at various price points as an enhancement to a facial.
at various price points+ depending on depth, often standalone.

## How They Actually Work

### Enzyme peels: digestion, not destruction

Plant enzymes — particularly papain (from papaya) and bromelain (from pineapple) — have a natural ability to break down proteins. The dead skin cells sitting on your skin's surface are protein structures (keratin). When the enzyme is applied to your skin, it specifically targets those dead cells, dissolving them while leaving living skin tissue beneath largely untouched.

This selectivity is why enzyme peels are so gentle. They don't strip living layers, they don't trigger acid burns, and they don't require neutralization. The enzymes just do their slow, targeted work. You'll typically feel a mild warmth or light tingling. After 10–15 minutes, the residue is removed and your skin looks visibly brighter and smoother.

### Chemical peels: controlled chemical injury

Chemical peels work on a completely different principle. The acid is applied to the skin, where it lowers the pH and chemically dissolves bonds between skin cells. Light peels (glycolic, lactic, mandelic) work on the stratum corneum — similar surface area to enzymes but through acid chemistry. Medium-depth peels (stronger TCA, Jessner's solution) penetrate into the epidermis. Deep peels (high-concentration TCA, phenol) reach the dermis.

The body responds with a controlled inflammatory and repair response. Old, damaged skin sloughs off; new skin replaces it. Properly done, this is what produces the dramatic results chemical peels are known for — even-toned, smoother, more youthful-looking skin. But the trade-off is real recovery, real risk if performed incorrectly, and a requirement for professional execution.

### Why enzyme peels fit our approach

We're partnered with Eminence Organic Skin Care, whose entire philosophy is biodynamic, plant-based, and gentle. Enzyme peels align directly with that — the ingredients are sustainably sourced fruits and herbs, and the mechanism is non-aggressive. For deeper chemical work, we'll refer you to a trusted dermatologist or med-spa partner. Both are real options. We just specialize in one.

## Which One Should You Choose?

### Choose an enzyme peel if…

- You have sensitive, reactive, or rosacea-prone skin.
- You're pregnant or nursing.
- You want to incorporate peels into a monthly routine without scheduling around downtime.
- You're new to peels and want to start gently.
- Your concerns are surface-level: dullness, mild texture, congestion, uneven tone from sun exposure.
- You prefer organic, plant-derived skincare and want your peel to match that philosophy.
- You're prepping for an event in the next few days and need a glow without recovery risk.

### Consider a chemical peel if…

- You have significant hyperpigmentation, melasma, or sun damage that hasn't responded to gentler treatments.
- You have acne scarring you want to meaningfully reduce.
- You have deeper wrinkles or significant texture changes from aging.
- You have time and willingness to manage 3–14 days of visible recovery.
- You're working with a dermatologist or qualified med-spa professional who can assess depth and risk for your specific situation.

### The honest middle ground

Many people benefit from **both, at different times**. Monthly enzyme peels as ongoing maintenance, with an occasional chemical peel at a medical setting for specific concerns. Your esthetician (us, or another local provider you trust) can help you think through what your skin actually needs across the year.

## What We Offer at Amber & Sage

We offer enzyme peels as an enhancement to our [Eminence organic facials](eminence-organic-facials-chattanooga.html). They're customized to your skin that day — brightening enzyme blends for dullness, exfoliating blends for congestion, calming enzyme masks for sensitive skin.

### The combination that works

Many of our regulars pair an enzyme peel with dermaplaning in the same session. The dermaplaning removes peach fuzz and dead surface skin manually; the enzyme peel then dissolves what's left chemically (gently). It's a strong one-two punch that doesn't require any recovery.

### When we'll refer you out

If you come in with concerns that require a deeper chemical peel — significant scarring, persistent melasma, depth issues an enzyme peel can't address — we'll tell you honestly and point you toward a Chattanooga dermatologist or qualified med-spa. We're not trying to be your only option; we're trying to be the right option when we are.

[Book a Facial with Enzyme Peel](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Are enzyme peels actually effective, or are they just gentler?**

Both. Enzyme peels are noticeably gentler than chemical peels, and they're also genuinely effective at dissolving dead surface skin, brightening tone, smoothing texture, and clearing congestion. They work through a different mechanism (enzymes vs. acids) but produce real, visible results — especially with consistent monthly use.

**Q: Which one should I get first if I've never had a peel?**

Almost always an enzyme peel. Lower risk, no acid, pregnancy-safe, and you'll see noticeable results without committing to the longer recovery window of a chemical peel. If your goals require deeper work (significant scarring, melasma, deep wrinkles), your esthetician will refer you to a medical setting for a chemical peel.

**Q: Can chemical peels be safe and "clean" too?**

Yes — light glycolic and lactic acid peels are widely used and safe when performed by trained professionals. The "clean" question is more about how often, how deep, and with what supporting ingredients. Both approaches can be part of a healthy skincare routine; they just answer different questions.

**Q: Why does Amber & Sage offer enzyme peels and not chemical peels?**

It comes down to philosophy and partnership. We're a holistic, organic-focused spa partnered with Eminence Organic Skin Care, whose entire approach is built around biodynamic, plant-derived ingredients. Enzyme peels fit that approach exactly. Chemical peels — particularly mid-depth and deep — are typically performed in medical or med-spa settings with physician oversight, which is the right context for that level of intervention.

**Q: How long do results last?**

Enzyme peel results typically last 2–4 weeks, aligning with your skin's natural renewal cycle. Most people incorporate them into a monthly facial routine for compounding effects. Chemical peel results last longer per session — light peels 4–6 weeks, deeper peels months — but require more recovery time and aftercare between sessions.

**Q: Can I do an enzyme peel during pregnancy?**

Yes — enzyme peels are generally considered pregnancy-safe because they use plant-derived enzymes rather than acids that could be absorbed. Always confirm with your provider and let your esthetician know you're pregnant so she can choose appropriate products. Chemical peels with salicylic acid, retinol, and stronger AHAs are typically avoided during pregnancy.

**Q: Can I combine an enzyme peel with dermaplaning?**

Yes — one of our favorite combinations. Dermaplaning first removes peach fuzz and dead surface skin manually; the enzyme peel then dissolves any remaining surface buildup. The two together produce noticeably more dramatic smoothness than either alone.

# Éminence Organic Facials

Eminence Organic Facials

# Skincare That *Listens* to Your Skin

Chattanooga's Proudly Partnered Eminence Organic Skin Care provider. Every facial customized in the moment — biodynamic ingredients, expert hands, and the kind of unhurried attention that actually moves the needle.

[Book a Facial](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)
[Meet the Estheticians](https://amberandsagespa.com/#team)

## What "Organic Facial" Actually Means Here

The phrase gets thrown around. At Amber & Sage, it means something specific: we are a **Proudly Partnered Eminence Organic Skin Care provider**, and every facial in our menu uses Eminence products as the foundation. Eminence is a Hungarian-rooted, biodynamically farmed line — meaning the herbs and fruits in your serum were grown using moon-cycle and soil-health principles, without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers.

What you'll *feel*: products that are gentle enough for the most reactive skin yet potent enough to address real concerns. Free of parabens, sodium lauryl sulfates, propylene glycol, mineral oils, and animal testing.

### Built around your skin, not a script

Every facial begins with a real consultation. Your esthetician will look at your skin under proper lighting, ask about your routine, your stressors, your meds, your hormones, your sleep — all the things that show up on the face. From there, she'll choose cleansers, exfoliants, masks, and finishing serums based on what your skin needs *today*, not a templated protocol.

This is the difference between an "organic facial" at a chain (same kit, every guest, every day) and a custom Eminence facial here: we build the treatment to you.

### Eminence Spa Partner

Only a small percentage of spas qualify as Proudly Partnered Eminence providers — the certification reflects ongoing training and a commitment to the line. We've been partnered since opening, and our retail shelf carries the full collection so you can continue at home.

### Enhancements that change a facial into a ritual

Each enhancement below can be added to a custom facial at booking. We've listed the price and time impact for each.

- **Éminence Enzyme** — A gentle yet effective exfoliation using natural fruit- or plant-derived enzymes to dissolve dead skin cells and impurities from the surface of the skin. Unlike harsh scrubs, enzymes work by breaking down the "glue" that holds dull, dry skin in place — revealing a smoother, brighter, and more radiant complexion underneath. Helps unclog pores, refine texture, and prepare the skin to better absorb nourishing products. [How enzymes compare to chemical peels →](enzyme-peel-vs-chemical-peel.html)
- **Dermaplane** — A gentle, non-invasive exfoliation treatment using a surgical-grade blade to carefully remove dead skin cells and fine vellus hair (peach fuzz). Instantly reveals smoother, brighter complexion, helps skincare penetrate more effectively, and makes makeup glide on flawlessly. [More on dermaplaning →](what-is-dermaplaning.html)
- **Light Therapy** (++15 min) — A gentle yet powerful treatment that penetrates deep into the skin to encourage healing from within. Stimulates collagen and elastin production, helping to soften fine lines and improve overall texture while also reducing redness and inflammation. [More on light therapy →](what-is-red-light-therapy.html)
- **High Frequency** (++5 min) — A gentle, non-invasive treatment that helps kill acne-causing bacteria, speed up the healing of breakouts, calm redness and inflammation, and boost circulation for a radiant, healthy glow. Leaves your skin feeling clarified, balanced, and deeply revitalized.
- **Facial Cupping** (++15 min) — A modified form of cupping therapy using low-pressure suction on facial tissues. Unlike body cupping, it does not leave bruising. Improves circulation, reduces puffiness, and supports lymphatic drainage.
- **Body Scrub** (++30 min) — A luxurious full-body exfoliation using Éminence's Coconut Sugar Scrub. Buffs away dead skin cells while organic coconut oil nourishes and softens. Includes a refreshing shower. [More on the body scrub →](body-scrub-chattanooga.html)
- **Aromatherapy** — Essential-oil pairing to anchor a particular emotional state during your treatment.

### What to expect on the day

We're **by appointment only**, so it's recommended you show up about 5 minutes early. When it's time to come inside, we'll send you a text message — that way you can sit in your car, take a quiet moment, and decompress instead of waiting in a lobby. Once you come in, you'll be greeted with your choice of soothing tea or cold water, settled in a robe, and walked back to a private treatment room.

Our standard facial runs 60 minutes as a base. We also offer a 30-minute **Express Facial** — a refreshing treatment designed for a quick glow-up and deep reset. This service includes a double cleanse with steam, a thorough skin analysis, and the application of Éminence Organic Skin Care products customized to your unique skin needs. Perfect for a lunchtime pick-me-up or when you're short on time but still want radiant, nourished skin.

On the other end, enhancements can extend a session well past 90 minutes: facial cupping adds 15, light therapy adds 15, high frequency adds 5, and so on. A full custom 60-minute facial typically includes double cleansing, exfoliation, a steam or warm cloth, extractions only if needed (and only if you want them), masks tailored to your skin, lymphatic facial massage, and a finishing serum and SPF. You'll leave with a tiny list of recommendations if you'd like one — never a hard retail pitch.

## Facials FAQ

**Q: What makes Eminence Organic Skin Care different?**

Eminence is a Hungarian-rooted, biodynamic and organic skincare line — sustainably farmed, free of parabens, sodium lauryl sulfates, mineral oils, and other harsh chemicals. Their formulations are exceptionally gentle while still being clinically effective.

**Q: How is your facial customized to my skin?**

Every facial begins with a skin analysis and consultation. Your esthetician selects cleansers, exfoliants, masks, and serums based on your skin's actual needs that day — not a fixed protocol.

**Q: Do I need dermaplaning or a peel?**

Both are optional enhancements. Dermaplaning removes peach fuzz and surface dead skin for an instant smooth feel; enzyme peels address texture, pigmentation, and aging more deeply. Your esthetician will recommend what's appropriate.

**Q: Is this safe for sensitive or acne-prone skin?**

Yes. Eminence is widely regarded as one of the gentlest professional lines on the market. Many of our clients came to us specifically because chain spas left their skin irritated or broken out.

**Q: How often should I get a facial?**

Once a month is the most common cadence — it matches your skin's renewal cycle. For specific concerns like acne or hyperpigmentation, we may recommend a tighter rhythm for a few months, then ease off.

**Q: Can I bring my own products?**

We use Eminence Organic Skin Care exclusively for our facials, so we can't substitute in products you bring from home. That said, if you have products you're already using and want guidance on — ingredient questions, whether they're working, how they layer with what we recommend — bring them along and your esthetician will happily talk through them with you.

# Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial

Source: https://amberandsagespa.com/what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html

Educational Guide

# What is an *Oxygen Facial?*

The pressurized-oxygen facial that Madonna made famous — explained without the celebrity gloss. Here's what's actually happening under the hood when an esthetician points that little wand at your face.

[Book an Intraceuticals Facial](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)
[How It Works](#how-it-works)

## The Short Answer

An oxygen facial is a non-invasive treatment in which a stream of **pressurized cold oxygen** is used to push specialized serums — typically hyaluronic-acid-based — into the upper layers of your skin. The result is immediate visible plumpness, hydration, brightness, and glow that conventional topical skincare can't replicate in a single session.

The treatment was developed and popularized by an Australian company called **Intraceuticals**, founded in 2002. Their hyperbaric oxygen infusion system became famous when Madonna mentioned it in the mid-2000s as a centerpiece of her skincare routine. Since then it's been used by Kim Kardashian, Bella Hadid, Eva Longoria, Justin Bieber, and dozens of other celebrities — and it's become the go-to "event facial" for weddings, photoshoots, and red carpets worldwide.

At Amber & Sage Spa, our version is called the **Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial**, a 45-minute treatment using the same Intraceuticals system found in luxury spas in London, Los Angeles, New York, and Sydney.

### Our Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial

Revitalize your skin with our Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial. This 45-minute treatment uses pressurized oxygen to infuse hyaluronic acid, vitamins, and antioxidants, instantly hydrating, plumping, and smoothing fine lines. Your skin will feel deeply nourished, refreshed, and glowing with a lifted, dewy complexion. Perfect for dry or tired skin, or as a pre-event glow-up — no downtime, just radiant results.

## How an Oxygen Facial Actually Works

### The basic mechanism

The Intraceuticals device delivers a continuous stream of pressurized, cool, purified oxygen through a handheld wand. Your esthetician moves the wand slowly across your skin while applying customized serums — one for hydration, another for firmness, another for brightening. The combination of **pressure and oxygen flow** drives the serum molecules deeper into the upper layers of your skin than they would penetrate from manual application alone.

The "hyperbaric" in the name refers to the fact that the oxygen is delivered above normal atmospheric pressure. This pressure differential is what creates the penetration effect — it's not magic, it's physics. Higher pressure outside the skin temporarily drives small molecules (especially hyaluronic acid) past the stratum corneum more effectively than gravity-driven topical absorption.

### What about the oxygen itself?

Here's an honest distinction: while oxygen is part of the experience, the visible immediate effects of an Intraceuticals facial are driven primarily by the **serum penetration** — especially the hyaluronic acid, which binds water and creates the plumping effect. The oxygen serves as the delivery medium and may have secondary cellular effects, but the headline-making results come from getting the serums where they need to go.

This matters because there are cheaper "oxygen facials" on the market that just use compressed-air machines and inexpensive serums. The Intraceuticals system is specifically engineered with calibrated pressure, proper oxygen purity, and pharmaceutical-grade serums — which is why it produces results those knockoff treatments don't.

### The Intraceuticals difference

Intraceuticals isn't a generic technique — it's a specific patented system using calibrated hyperbaric oxygen and proprietary serums developed in Australia over the last 20+ years. When you book with us, you're getting the same protocol used at the spas that made oxygen facials famous — not a budget imitation.

## What an Oxygen Facial Helps With

### Immediate visible glow

This is the headline. Your skin will look measurably plumper, more hydrated, more even-toned, and more luminous within minutes of the treatment ending. The effect is so immediate that the treatment is famously the choice of Hollywood makeup artists for pre-event prep.

### Hydration that lasts

The hyaluronic acid delivered during the session binds water in the skin for days afterward. Chronic dehydration — especially common during winter, after long flights, or with certain medications — responds particularly well.

### Sensitive skin and post-procedure recovery

Because the treatment is completely non-invasive, doesn't use heat, doesn't use acids, and doesn't require manual extraction, it's safe for very sensitive skin. People recovering from laser treatments, microneedling, or other more aggressive procedures often book oxygen facials as gentle restoration sessions.

### Event prep

The most common reason people book Intraceuticals. Weddings, photoshoots, reunions, milestone birthdays, professional headshots, big presentations. The timing sweet spot is **5–7 days before** the event — long enough for any subtle redness to resolve, close enough that the visible plumpness and glow are still present.

### Aging concerns (with the right expectations)

For fine lines and surface aging, oxygen facials produce a real but temporary improvement — the hydration plumps the lines and the glow softens the look of surface texture. For deeper structural aging concerns, this is a complement to other treatments rather than a substitute.

## What an Intraceuticals Session Looks Like

### Arrival and consultation

You'll be welcomed in with your choice of soothing tea or cold water, settled in a robe, and walked back to a private treatment room. Your esthetician will look at your skin under proper lighting, ask about your goals, and choose the right serum protocol for the day.

### Cleansing and prep

Double cleansing, gentle exfoliation if appropriate, and skin prep. This is the same foundation as any quality facial — the Intraceuticals portion is the layered enhancement, not the entire treatment.

### The oxygen infusion

Your esthetician applies the first serum and uses the Intraceuticals wand to deliver the pressurized oxygen across your face, neck, and (usually) décolletage. You'll feel a gentle, cool stream of air — many guests find it pleasantly relaxing, almost lulling. The infusion phase typically takes 15–20 minutes. Multiple serums may be layered in sequence.

### Finishing

A mask is applied while you rest. Your esthetician then finishes with a hydrating serum and SPF. You can wear makeup the same day — though many guests choose not to, because their skin already looks better than it would with makeup.

### Walking out

The visible difference is striking. You'll see it in the mirror, your friends will see it, and you'll see it photograph beautifully for the next several days.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Why are oxygen facials sometimes called "Madonna facials"?**

Madonna famously credited Intraceuticals oxygen infusion as a key part of her skincare routine in the mid-2000s, popularizing the treatment among celebrities and the entertainment press. The nickname stuck. Other celebrities reported as fans include Kim Kardashian, Bella Hadid, and Eva Longoria.

**Q: Does an oxygen facial actually deliver oxygen into the skin?**

The mechanism is more nuanced than that. The hyperbaric oxygen creates pressurized airflow that pushes the hyaluronic-acid serum into the skin's upper layers more effectively than topical application alone. The oxygen itself isn't the primary therapeutic agent — it's the pressure and the serum penetration that produce the visible plumping and hydration effects.

**Q: How quickly will I see results?**

Immediately — that's the defining feature. Skin looks plumper, more hydrated, brighter, and more even-toned right off the table. This is why oxygen facials are the go-to choice for events, photoshoots, and weddings. Effects typically last 5–10 days, longer with consistent monthly treatments.

**Q: Is an Intraceuticals facial safe for sensitive skin?**

Yes — it's one of the gentlest professional facials available. The treatment uses cold pressurized oxygen and hyaluronic-acid-based serums; no heat, no acids, no manual extraction required. People with rosacea, very sensitive skin, and post-procedure recovery often choose Intraceuticals specifically for this reason.

**Q: How often should I get an oxygen facial?**

For maintenance: monthly is the most common cadence. For event-driven booking (wedding, photoshoot, milestone birthday): one 5–7 days before the event for optimal results. For deeper cumulative effects: a series of treatments over 4–6 weeks before a major event or season.

**Q: Can I get one while pregnant?**

Yes — Intraceuticals is generally considered pregnancy-safe because there's no heat, no acids, and no aggressive techniques. Let your esthetician know you're pregnant so she can choose appropriate serums (avoiding any with retinol or salicylic acid).

**Q: Are there any contraindications?**

The treatment is contraindicated for people using Accutane (within six months), recent laser or microneedling (wait the recommended healing window), active herpes simplex outbreaks, and certain skin cancers in the treatment area. Your esthetician will screen for these in the consultation.

**Q: What does it feel like?**

Comfortable and surprisingly relaxing. The oxygen stream is cool, light, and steady — many guests describe it as soothing. There's no pinching, no scraping, no heat. Most people leave the treatment feeling both refreshed and rested.

# Microdermabrasion Facial

Source: https://amberandsagespa.com/microderm-facial-chattanooga.html

Microdermabrasion in Chattanooga

# Smooth, Bright, *Renewed*

Diamond-tip microdermabrasion at Amber & Sage Spa — the professional resurfacing treatment that makes skin look immediately smoother, brighter, and more refined. Available as a 30-minute express or full 60-minute facial.

[Book a Microderm](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)
[What It Does](#what-it-does)

## What Microdermabrasion Actually Does

Microdermabrasion is a professional skin-resurfacing treatment that uses a diamond-tipped wand to mechanically exfoliate the outermost layer of dead skin cells, while gentle suction lifts away the debris. The result is immediate visible smoothness, brightness, and refinement — skin that catches the light better, reflects more evenly, and feels noticeably different to the touch.

Unlike the older crystal-based microdermabrasion machines you may have encountered at chain spas, our system uses a precision-controlled diamond tip. Cleaner, more comfortable, and capable of varying intensity across different areas of your face based on what your skin needs.

## What It Addresses

- **Surface texture and roughness** — the most immediately visible improvement.
- **Dullness** — freshly resurfaced skin reflects light more evenly, restoring glow.
- **Fine lines** — not deep wrinkles, but the surface lines that show up in photos.
- **Enlarged pores** — the suction and exfoliation together visibly refine pore appearance.
- **Mild acne scarring** — with a series of treatments, surface texture from old breakouts can soften meaningfully.
- **Mild hyperpigmentation** — surface-level discoloration responds well; deeper pigmentation needs additional approaches.
- **Product absorption** — whatever skincare you apply afterward penetrates more effectively for the next several days.

### Microderm vs. dermaplaning — what's the difference?

Both mechanically exfoliate the skin's surface. [Dermaplaning](what-is-dermaplaning.html) uses a sterile blade to scrape away dead skin and peach fuzz. Microdermabrasion uses a diamond tip with suction to abrade and lift cells across a broader depth. Microderm is generally more aggressive for texture and pore concerns; dermaplaning is gentler and additionally removes vellus hair. Many of our regulars alternate between the two month-to-month.

## Two Ways to Book

### Express Microderm Facial — 30 minutes,

An express version of the hour-long skin-smoothing treatment that uses a diamond tip to gently exfoliate and resurface, helping to improve texture, brighten tone, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and pores. Great for maintenance between full facials, or as a "between-event" refresher.

### Microderm Facial — 1 hour,

This skin-smoothing treatment uses a diamond tip to gently exfoliate and resurface, helping to improve texture, brighten tone, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and pores. Includes a soothing mask and a relaxing neck and décolleté massage to leave your skin refreshed, radiant, and renewed.

[Book a Microderm Facial](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)

## What to Expect

Your esthetician will begin with a thorough cleanse and skin analysis. The microdermabrasion handpiece moves slowly across your skin in overlapping passes — you'll feel a firm, slightly scratchy sensation along with the gentle vacuum lifting away the exfoliated cells. Treatment areas typically include face, neck, and décolleté.

The intensity is calibrated to your skin's tolerance and your specific concerns. Areas with stubborn texture get more focused attention; sensitive areas get a lighter touch.

The full 60-minute treatment also includes a soothing mask phase and a relaxing neck and décolleté massage — the spa experience layered on top of the resurfacing work. Your esthetician will finish with serums, moisturizer, and SPF.

### Aftercare matters

- **SPF religiously** for the next several days — freshly resurfaced skin is more sun-sensitive.
- **No exfoliating acids** (glycolic, salicylic, retinol) for 48–72 hours.
- **Hydrating serums and moisturizer** are well-absorbed for several days afterward.
- **Avoid heat** (saunas, hot showers, intense workouts) for 24 hours.

### When to schedule

For event prep (wedding, photoshoot, big presentation), book microderm **5–7 days before** — long enough for any pinkness to resolve, close enough for the smoothness and glow to still be at its peak. For ongoing maintenance, monthly is the standard cadence.

## Who Microderm Is Best For

- **Mature skin** — cell turnover slows with age, and microderm directly compensates.
- **Sun-damaged skin** — surface roughness and minor hyperpigmentation from years of Tennessee sun.
- **Acne-prone or post-acne skin** — texture from old breakouts softens meaningfully with a series of treatments.
- **Anyone with congested pores** — the suction component is particularly effective.
- **Pre-event glow** — one of the most-booked services in the weeks before a wedding.

### Who should consider an alternative

- **Active acne or open lesions** — we'll typically recommend our [Acne Facial](acne-facial-chattanooga.html) protocol instead.
- **Rosacea or very reactive skin** — the mechanical exfoliation can aggravate; an [Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow Facial](what-is-an-oxygen-facial.html) may be gentler.
- **Pregnancy** — microderm itself isn't contraindicated, but we'll talk through it during consultation.
- **Recent Accutane use** — wait at least 6 months after stopping.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is microdermabrasion?**

Microdermabrasion is a professional skin-resurfacing treatment that uses a diamond-tipped wand to mechanically exfoliate the outermost layer of dead skin cells while gentle suction lifts away the debris. It's non-invasive, requires no downtime, and produces immediate visible smoothness and brightness.

**Q: How is microdermabrasion different from dermaplaning?**

Both are mechanical exfoliation, but they work differently. Dermaplaning uses a sterile blade to scrape away dead skin cells and peach fuzz at the surface. Microdermabrasion uses a diamond tip and suction to abrade and lift dead skin cells across a broader depth. Microderm tends to be more effective for texture, pores, and fine lines; dermaplaning is gentler and additionally removes vellus hair.

**Q: Does it hurt?**

No. Most clients describe it as a firm scratching sensation across the skin, similar to a cat's tongue. The suction is gentle and the diamond tip is precisely controlled by your esthetician. Some areas may feel more intense than others, particularly around the nose.

**Q: Is there downtime?**

Essentially none. Skin may look slightly pink for an hour or two — sometimes longer for sensitive skin. SPF is essential for the next several days because freshly exfoliated skin is more sun-sensitive. You can wear makeup the same day, though many people choose not to because their skin already looks better.

**Q: How often should I get microdermabrasion?**

Once a month aligns with your skin's natural renewal cycle for ongoing maintenance. For specific concerns like sun damage, acne scarring, or significant texture issues, a series of 4–6 treatments spaced 2–3 weeks apart produces noticeably more dramatic results.

**Q: Can I combine microderm with other treatments?**

Yes. Microderm pairs well with hydrating serums, light masks, and finishing protocols like LED therapy. We generally wouldn't combine it with chemical peels in the same session, and we'd avoid stacking it with aggressive enzyme exfoliation. Your esthetician will design the right combination for your skin.

# Acne Facial

Source: https://amberandsagespa.com/acne-facial-chattanooga.html

Acne Facial in Chattanooga

# The Comprehensive *Reset*

For breakout-prone skin that hasn't responded to skincare alone. A six-step, multi-modality protocol that combines what actually works on acne: extractions, enzyme exfoliation, high frequency therapy, and red light..

[Book the Acne Facial](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)
[What's Inside](#whats-inside)

## Why a Multi-Modality Approach

Acne isn't one thing. It's a system: oil production, bacteria, dead skin cell turnover, inflammation, hormones, and stress all interact. A single-modality treatment — just extractions, or just a peel, or just light therapy — addresses one piece while the others continue driving the cycle. That's why so many people spend years on rotating products that work for two weeks and then stop.

Our Acne Facial protocol combines six steps that address different points in the cycle — in a single 90-minute session, performed by a trained esthetician. It's not magic. It's the layered approach that dermatology offices use, executed in a calming spa environment with organic products and proper aftercare guidance.

## The Six-Step Protocol

Here's what actually happens in your session:

### 1. Double cleanse

An oil-based first cleanse removes makeup, SPF, and sebum. A water-based second cleanse removes water-soluble debris. This sets the skin up for everything that follows — you cannot effectively treat what you cannot see.

### 2. Detailed skin analysis

Your esthetician examines your skin under proper lighting, identifying the type and distribution of breakouts (hormonal, congestion, comedonal, inflammatory), areas of irritation, and any signs of barrier compromise. The treatment plan adapts based on what she finds.

### 3. Manual extractions

The skin is softened with steam to facilitate gentle extraction. Your esthetician removes blackheads, whiteheads, and any ready-to-go congestion using proper technique — pressure calibrated, never forced. We don't extract anything that isn't ready. Forcing closed comedones is how marks form.

### 4. Éminence enzyme exfoliation

Plant-derived enzymes from papaya and pumpkin dissolve dead skin cells around hair follicles — the very area where congestion forms. This is a gentler approach than acid exfoliation and it pairs beautifully with the manual extractions that came before.

### 5. High frequency therapy

A glass electrode delivers low-level alternating current across your skin, producing ozone at the surface. The mechanism: ozone kills the bacteria implicated in acne (*Cutibacterium acnes*), and the gentle electrical stimulation reduces inflammation. This is the step that targets the bacterial side of the equation.

### 6. Red light therapy

The session finishes with LED red light to reduce inflammation, support skin healing, and calm any redness from the extractions. Red light also has documented effects on sebum production over a series of treatments.

### One protocol, all six steps

Around 90 minutes. You leave with calmer, cleaner skin and a realistic action plan for what to do at home. This isn't a quick fix — it's a real reset. Most clients see meaningful improvement after their second or third session.

## What Makes This Different From a "Regular Facial"

### Real extractions

Many spas avoid extractions or do them perfunctorily because they take time and require training. Improper extractions create more problems than they solve. We take extractions seriously — trained estheticians, proper preparation, and the discipline to leave alone what isn't ready.

### Active modalities, not just products

High frequency and red light therapy aren't add-ons here — they're core to the protocol. Each does something a topical product can't.

### Organic products throughout

We're an Éminence-partnered spa. Every product touching your skin during the protocol is biodynamic and organic. This matters especially for inflamed, compromised acne-prone skin that reacts to harsher conventional ingredients.

### Aftercare guidance

You leave with realistic at-home recommendations — not a sales pitch. We'll tell you what to use, when to use it, and what to stop using. If something doesn't need to change, we'll say so.

[Book the Acne Facial](https://booking.mangomint.com/101649?showOnlyScId=9)

## Who This Is For

- **Active breakouts** that haven't responded to drugstore skincare or rotating products.
- **Hormonal acne** — particularly the persistent jawline and chin breakouts.
- **Adult-onset acne** in your 20s, 30s, 40s, when you'd thought this was behind you.
- **Comedonal congestion** — blackheads and whiteheads without active inflammation.
- **Post-Accutane maintenance** — once you're at least 6 months past treatment.
- **Pregnancy-friendly** — we'll skip any contraindicated steps and adapt the protocol for safe use.
- **Combination skin with periodic flare-ups** — the protocol works as periodic reset.

## When to Pair With a Dermatologist Instead

Spa acne facials are excellent for inflammatory, comedonal, and hormonal acne in the mild-to-moderate range, and for maintenance and prevention. They are **complementary, not substitutive**, for these situations:

- Cystic acne or severe inflammatory acne — needs medical management.
- Suspected fungal acne — needs specific antifungal treatment.
- Hidradenitis suppurativa or other diagnosed acne-like conditions.
- Acne that's left significant scarring — medical interventions (lasers, microneedling, peels in a clinical setting) may be appropriate alongside this protocol.

We'll tell you honestly if your situation calls for dermatologic care first. The Acne Facial protocol is excellent at what it does, and we won't pretend it's the right tool for situations where medicine is needed.

## What to Expect After Your Session

### Immediately

Your skin will look calmer and cleaner. You may have mild redness for an hour or two, particularly where extractions were done. No makeup for at least 12 hours; SPF religiously.

### Days 1–3

For most people, skin looks meaningfully better. For some, a brief "purge" surfaces — congestion that was already developing comes up faster than it would have. This is normal and short-lived.

### Days 4–14

The full effect of the high frequency and light therapy work continues through the cellular response. Inflammation reduces, healing accelerates, and the bacterial load stays lower for longer.

### Recommended cadence

For active acne: every 2–3 weeks until the cycle calms down (typically 3–6 sessions). For maintenance once your skin stabilizes: monthly. We'll talk through a realistic timeline at your first visit.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What's actually in an Acne Facial at Amber & Sage?**

Six distinct steps: double cleansing, detailed skin analysis, manual extractions, Éminence enzyme exfoliation, soothing mask, high frequency therapy to kill acne-causing bacteria, and finishing red light therapy to reduce inflammation. The full protocol takes about 90 minutes.

**Q: Will an Acne Facial make my skin worse before it gets better?**

Sometimes, yes — a temporary "purge" after deep extractions and enzyme exfoliation is normal. Congestion that was already developing surfaces faster than it would have on its own. This usually clears within 5–7 days, and the skin underneath emerges meaningfully better.

**Q: How often should I get an Acne Facial?**

For active breakouts: every 2–3 weeks until the cycle calms down (typically 3–6 sessions). For maintenance once your skin stabilizes: monthly. We'll talk through a realistic timeline at your first visit.

**Q: Will extractions leave marks?**

Done correctly, no. Our estheticians use proper technique — softening the skin with steam and enzyme first, applying calibrated pressure, never forcing closed comedones. Minor redness for an hour or two is normal; persistent marks indicate either improper technique elsewhere or unusually reactive skin (which we'll account for next time).

**Q: Can I wear makeup afterward?**

Better not to for at least 12 hours. Your skin is at its most receptive to whatever you put on it. SPF is the one exception — sun protection is essential the next several days.

**Q: Is this safe during pregnancy?**

The base protocol is safe with adaptations. We may skip certain steps (high frequency in particular requires individual evaluation) and choose pregnancy-safe products throughout. Tell us when you book so we can plan accordingly.

**Q: What products should I use at home?**

Your esthetician will give you specific recommendations based on what she sees. In general: a gentle cleanser, an Éminence-line treatment serum, a non-comedogenic moisturizer, and SPF every morning. We'll tell you what to *stop* using too, which is often more impactful than what to add.
